blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS) , a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS-Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.

Dense检索器和Retrival-Augmented Generation(RAG)管道将查询与专题文件匹配,但及时性差,因此显示内容在专题上但时间上是错误的。 我们提出了临时文本相似性(TTS),这项任务衡量两个定着的文本在时间上是否一致,而不考虑其主题相似性。 然后,我们介绍TEMPS(精密搜索的瞬间嵌入模型),这是一个模块化的时空分支,它与一个冻结的语义检索器和该信号上的列车相连。 它解决了锚定的时间表达方式,将每个时间间隔和瞬间比对一个高斯人;由此产生的命令监督一个锚定日期条件的编码器,我们在推论中将其分数与语义分数结合. 定位提供监管,因此训练没有使用手贴时间数据. 时间分数本身是来自分布式嵌入的Gaussian-KL的包含度量;TEMPS添加的是地面分数和瞬间匹配的监督. 在三个时间基准上,TEMPS改进了每个经测试的语义主干线的MRR,在TS-Retriever上,将R@1从19.92提升至25.39,高于之前的时间状态.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Information Retrieval (IR) underpins many Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications, including information extraction, topic detection, and summarization. Traditional IR has largely focused on semantic relevance, matching documents to queries by topical similarity Campos et al. (2014) ; Rizzo et al. (2022) , yet many information needs are also inherently temporal Alonso et al. (2011) : when something happened can matter as much as what happened. Many documents carry timestamps, and their text often anchors events in time as
well, whether with an absolute expression (e.g., “on January 15th, 2008”) or a
deictic one resolved against that timestamp (e.g., “last summer”) Derczynski et al. (2012) ;
interpreting these contexts is essential for results that are both topically and
temporally relevant Campos et al. (2014) ; Han et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: Failing to account for temporal constraints can lead to factually correct but contextually misleading answers. Figure 1 illustrates this: given the query “Who was the Director-General of the World Health Organization between 2006 and 2017?”, two passages appear semantically relevant, yet only one aligns with the correct time frame. The passage directly below the correct one is just as topical but covers a tenure outside the requested window, and a retriever scoring only topical relevance cannot separate them. Without temporal reasoning, IR systems risk returning outdated, premature, or otherwise temporally mismatched information, undermining trust in downstream applications such as search, question answering, and decision support.

blocks.en: This need spans many domains: clinical narratives, where diagnoses and treatments unfold over time Moharasar and Ho (2016) ; journalism, where ignoring a publication date recirculates outdated stories as misinformation Musi and Rocci (2022) ; and legal contexts, where a document’s validity depends on its date of enactment. Even consumer search for reviews or events relies on temporal alignment to stay relevant.

However, dense retrievers inherit their representations from encoders such as
BERT Devlin et al. (2019) , ModernBERT Warner et al. (2025) , and

The result is temporally brittle retrieval that matches on semantics while missing time-sensitive relationships, returning temporally incorrect documents.

blocks.en: Temporal cues compound this problem, since they are often implicit or ambiguous. Resolving “earlier this year” requires the document’s publication date, while “five years from now” requires arithmetic over an anchor; without dedicated modeling, such cases yield irrelevant results.
blocks.zh: 时间提示加剧了这一问题,因为它们往往含蓄或含糊不清。 解决 " 今年更早 " 的问题需要文件的出版日期,而 " 五年之后 " 则需要算出一个主播;没有专门的模型,这类案件就会产生无关紧要的结果。

blocks.en: A central difficulty is that temporal compatibility is often asymmetric . A passage about “in 2020” is compatible with a query about a specific date that year, but a passage about a single day should not be equally compatible with a query about the whole year. Symmetric functions such as cosine similarity or interval overlap cannot express this directionality, scoring “day contained in year” and “year contains day” identically. This motivates modeling temporal expressions as distributions, where the mean captures location, the variance captures granularity or uncertainty, and a directional divergence distinguishes fine-to-coarse compatibility from its reverse.

retriever. To represent and compare intervals, we adopt the asymmetric Gaussian-KL scoring
used in prior distributional embedding work Vilnis and McCallum (2014) ; He et al. (2015) ; Yoda et al. (2024) : its directional divergence gives us the
fine-to-coarse asymmetry that temporal inclusion needs; what is new is the
temporal grounding and the moment-matched interval-to-Gaussian supervision, not
the divergence.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 初步情况

blocks.en: Temporal information facilitates time-aware retrieval through computable relations Allen (1983) , hierarchical granularity, and normalizable expressions Pustejovsky et al. (2003) . These expressions are categorized by their grounding Derczynski et al. (2012) : absolute (explicit timestamps like “January 15th”), deictic (speaker-relative, e.g., “yesterday”), anaphoric (relative to a prior reference), and duration (defined spans).

blocks.en: TimeML Pustejovsky et al. (2003) ; Pustejovsky et al. (2005) ; Pustejovsky et al. (2010) is the standard markup for annotating these expressions in natural language Jia et al. blocks.en: TEMPS covers expressions that can be anchored and resolved to an interval: absolute dates, deictic expressions and offsets resolved against the anchor date, PRESENT_REF -style references, seasons, durations, and intervals. It does not perform discourse-level reasoning: references needing an unobserved antecedent, unanchored vague ordering, and event-event relations lie outside what the supervision teaches, and the pipeline inherits the tagger’s misses.

blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) incorporates time into search by exploiting document timestamps, temporal expressions, and explicit or implicit temporal intent in queries Campos et al. (2014) ; Kanhabua and Anand (2016) . This allows systems to rank documents by both topical and temporal relevance, which is essential for dynamic collections where the same entity or event may have different correct interpretations at different times.

blocks.en: Gaussian embeddings represent items as distributions rather than points, allowing the mean to encode location and the covariance to encode uncertainty or generality. Vilnis and McCallum Vilnis and McCallum (2014) use KL divergence between Gaussian word embeddings to model asymmetric inclusion in lexical semantics; KG2E He et al. (2015) applies Gaussian embeddings and asymmetric KL to directional knowledge-graph relations; and GaussCSE Yoda et al. (2024) uses a bounded inverse-KL score for entailment-oriented sentence similarity. TEMPS follows this lineage rather than introducing a new Gaussian divergence or similarity head. Its novelty is temporal: grounded intervals are converted into Gaussian supervision by moment matching, and an anchor-date-conditioned branch learns to reproduce this temporal compatibility signal for retrieval.

blocks.en:
TS-Retriever and TSContriever Wu et al. (2024) directly address time-sensitive
retrieval: the benchmark pairs semantically similar but temporally distinct
documents, and the model fine-tunes Contriever Izacard et al. (2021) on contrastive
pairs whose negatives are built by perturbing the time specifier in the question
while holding the passage fixed. This line of work shows the value of temporal supervision, but existing approaches remain tied to specific retriever training setups. In contrast, our work introduces TTS as a temporal similarity objective and TEMPS as a modular temporal component that can be combined with different semantic retrievers.

blocks.en: Despite progress in STS, TIR, and RAG, current embedding models remain limited on temporally rich text. Standard similarity functions such as cosine similarity are symmetric and cannot naturally represent asymmetric relations such as a specific date being contained in a broader interval. Moreover, existing STS resources do not teach models to ignore topical similarity when temporal information conflicts. These gaps motivate temporally aware representations and datasets that explicitly model temporal alignment.

blocks.en: 4 Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 问题定义

blocks.en: We propose the Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS) task to improve time-aware IR models. Designed as a temporal analogue of the STS task, TTS trains embedding models to measure the alignment of temporal information expressed in sentences.

blocks.en: Figure 2: TEMPS’ Model Architecture

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows TEMPS, which consists of a semantic branch and a temporal branch. The semantic branch supplies the standard dense representation used for topical relevance. The temporal branch receives a passage and an anchor date, encodes the passage with a frozen all-MiniLM-L6-v2 backbone at up to 512 tokens, encodes the date with a sinusoidal positional representation, and maps the combined representation to a Gaussian embedding. Following prior Gaussian embedding models Vilnis and McCallum (2014) ; Yoda et al. (2024) , the mean captures temporal location, while the diagonal variance captures temporal granularity and uncertainty.

blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate TEMPS on three temporal retrieval benchmarks: TimeQA Chen et al. (2021) , which tests evolving facts over long documents; TempReason Tan et al. (2023) , which evaluates date arithmetic and event-time grounding; and TS-Retriever Wu et al. (2024) , which stresses retrieval among semantically similar but temporally mismatched documents. We compare against lexical, rule-based, dense, LLM-based, and temporal retrieval baselines, including BM25, SUTime Chang and Manning (2012) , MPNet base -v2 Song et al. (2020) , E5 base -v2 Wang et al. (2022) , BGE large -v1.5 Xiao et al. (2024) , Mistral, and TSContriever Wu et al. (2024) . For each dense retriever, we also report the corresponding +TEMPS variant and a rule-based +SUTime control described below. To test whether temporal retrieval gains transfer to an end task, we additionally evaluate a TimeQA RAG pipeline that retrieves the top-5 passages and uses Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Yang et al. (2024) as the generator.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个时间检索基准评价TeEMPS:TimeQA Chen等人(2021年),通过长文件检验不断演变的事实;Tempreason Tan等人(2023年),评价日期算术和事件时间定位;TS-Retriever Wu等人(2024年),强调在类似但时间不匹配的文件中检索。 我们比较了词汇、规则、密度、LLM和时间检索基线,包括BM25、SUTime Chang和Manning(2012年)、MPNet基础-v2 Song等人(2020年)、E5基础-v2 Wang等人(2022年)、BGE大型-v1.5 萧等人(2024年),米斯特拉尔,和TSContriever Wu等人(2024年). 对于每个密集的检索器,我们也报告相应的+TEMPS变体以及下文描述的基于规则的+SUTime控制. 为了检验时间检索是否将时间检索收益转移到一项结束任务,我们额外评价了一条TimeQA RAG管道,该管道回收了前5个通道,并使用Quen2.5-7B-Instruct Yang et al. (2024)作为发电机.

blocks.en: For retrieval, we report MRR, NDCG@5, Recall@5, and Precision@5. For downstream RAG, we report only answer-level metrics: exact match (EM), token-level F1, and answer containment. The temporal-semantic interpolation parameter α \alpha is a benchmark-level calibration parameter, not a trained model parameter, and we select it on a held-out split. Each benchmark is partitioned at random into 20% validation and 80% test; one α \alpha per benchmark is chosen from validation MRR alone and then held fixed across every backbone, metric, and significance test, and the test split is scored once. This selects α = 0.6 \alpha=0.6 for TimeQA, 0.8 0.8 for TempReason, and 0.3 0.3 for TS-Retriever. Every number reported below is a test-split number. Additional benchmark statistics, baseline descriptions, and computational details are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: These RAG results provide a downstream validation of the TTS objective: better temporal alignment in retrieval leads to better generated answers, not only better ranking scores. They also address the practical concern that improvements at deeper retrieval ranks may not affect top-sensitive pipelines. Although the generator sees only the top-5 retrieved passages, temporalized retrievers consistently produce more correct final answers, indicating that TEMPS improves the evidence available to the generator in the part of the ranking that directly matters for RAG. This is our only end-to-end evaluation: a second answer-level task needs both genuine temporal retrieval constraints and trustworthy answer-level ground truth under a comparable protocol, and no benchmark we examined supplied both.

blocks.en: Our results show that correctly modeling temporal information yields larger gains than simply scaling model size. Across all three benchmarks, E ​ 5 b ​ a ​ s ​ e E5_{base} -v2 + TEMPS obtains a higher MRR than the unaugmented 7B-parameter Mistral model despite having around 50 times fewer parameters, though on TempReason the margin ( 0.6278 0.6278 vs. 0.6191 0.6191 ) is too small to carry weight and the 7B model remains well ahead on Recall@5. Scaling remains useful when the temporal module is also added, as Mistral + TEMPS obtains the best MRR on all three datasets. However, the unaugmented 7B model is consistently weaker than much smaller temporalized encoders. These results highlight that temporal modeling can outweigh raw capacity increases, especially on tasks with strong temporal dependencies, which is important for resource-constrained retrieval systems.

blocks.en: TEMPS adds only a lightweight temporal embedding module to an existing model, increasing parameter count by approximately 27M in our experiments. Even when applied to small embedding models like E ​ 5 b ​ a ​ s ​ e E5_{base} -v2, it delivers performance competitive with, and often exceeding, the unaugmented 7B-parameter Mistral model. Furthermore, TEMPS can be attached to different semantic embedding models without retraining the semantic component, making it a modular addition to existing retrieval pipelines. This makes the approach suitable for real-world systems where both latency and memory footprint are critical constraints. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: While large language models and dense retrieval methods have advanced the field of information retrieval, they often fall short in addressing temporal reasoning, an essential factor for accurately interpreting time-sensitive user queries. To tackle this limitation, we proposed a novel framework called TEMPS based on the Temporal Textual Similarity task, leveraging weak supervision and synthetic data to train a dedicated embedding model that captures temporal information in documents. Our evaluations show MRR improvements over existing baselines for every semantic backbone tested. A rule-based control that swaps SUTime grounding into the same fusion falls below the semantic baseline on TimeQA and TS-Retriever, locating the gain in the learned representation; on TempReason it is stronger, and TEMPS trades top-5 coverage for a better top-1. The benefit is concentrated where topical and temporal relevance conflict, not on queries a tagger already resolves.
blocks.zh: 虽然大型语言模型和密集检索方法已推进了信息检索领域,但它们往往未能解决时间推理问题,而时间推理是准确解释对时间有敏感认识的用户查询的基本因素。 为了克服这一限制,我们提出了一个名为TEMPS的新框架,其基础是临时文本相似性任务,利用薄弱的监督和合成数据来培训一种专门嵌入模型,在文件中收集时间信息。 我们的评价表明,经测试的每个语义主干线的MRR比现有基线有所改善。 基于规则的将SUTime定位为同一聚变的控制,低于TimeQA和TS-Retriever上的语义基线,定位到学到的表示中的收益;在Tempereason上它更强大,TEMPS交易前5覆盖,以更好的顶-1. 好处集中在专题和时间冲突,而不是标记者已经解决的查询上。

blocks.en: While our explicit temporal modeling proves effective, several promising directions remain open. First, tighter integration of semantic and temporal embeddings, via joint training or attention-based fusion, could improve robustness against semantically similar yet temporally incongruent distractors. Second, extending TEMPS to implicit temporal references and event-based reasoning would broaden its applicability to real-world narrative and conversational domains. Third, scaling data generation to diverse large-scale open corpora could enhance coverage of rare temporal expressions. Finally, we aim to explore multilingual retrieval and lightweight modules for low-latency, resource-constrained environments.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们明确的时间模式证明是有效的,但若干有希望的方向仍然开放。 首先,通过联合培训或基于注意力的聚变,更紧密地整合语义和时间嵌入,可以提高强健性,对抗类似但时间上不和谐的分散干扰器。 第二,将TeEMPS扩大到隐含的时间参考和基于事件的推理,将扩大其适用于现实世界的叙述和对话领域。 第三,将数据生成规模扩大为多种大型开放公司可以扩大稀有时间表达的覆盖面。 最后,我们的目标是探索多语种检索和轻量级模块,用于低纬度、资源有限的环境。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation focuses on benchmarks with explicit temporal annotations and reliable timestamps, enabling controlled comparison but not covering all real-world variability in temporal language or metadata quality. All experiments are conducted in English; we have not evaluated TEMPS on other languages, and its effectiveness in multilingual or cross-lingual settings remains an open question. Our temporal supervision is built from synthetic templates and a rule-based, HeidelTime-tagged resource, and it grounds anchored, resolvable temporal expressions; implicit or highly ambiguous references and event–event relations (e.g., TempReason Level 3) are outside our current scope, and the weak supervision inherits any noise from the underlying tagger. The temporal–semantic weight α \alpha is selected per benchmark on a held-out validation split from MRR alone, which keeps the protocol uniform but accepts a coverage cost: on TempReason, where validation MRR peaks at α = 0.8 \alpha=0.8 , adding TEMPS lowers Recall@5 for all four backbones and NDCG@5 for two of them, and a rule-based SUTime control outperforms it on every metric. We report this rather than tune around it; the benefit of the learned encoder is concentrated where topical and temporal relevance conflict, not on queries an off-the-shelf tagger already resolves. Reported results come from a single training run (seed 42), with statistical significance measured across queries rather than across training seeds. TEMPS is also model-agnostic and thus inherits the biases and factual gaps of the semantic backbone it augments, a trade-off we accept to ensure modularity and ease of integration. The retrieval unit is a passage of up to 512 tokens, and attention pooling collapses however many temporal expressions it contains into a single Gaussian, which is a lossy summary for long or temporally heterogeneous passages; passages with no temporal expression are still encoded at inference but are held out of temporal training, so their Gaussians are uncalibrated and the semantic branch is what ranks them. Our downstream evidence rests on a single end-to-end task (TimeQA RAG with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), because we found no second benchmark supplying both genuine temporal retrieval constraints and trustworthy answer-level ground truth under a comparable protocol. Finally, while the added temporal encoding introduces a small computational overhead, it remains far lower than the cost of scaling to much larger models for comparable gains.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价侧重于具有明确时间说明和可靠时间戳的基准,以便能够进行有控制的比较,但不涵盖时间语言或元数据质量方面所有现实世界的可变性。 所有实验都用英语进行;我们没有评估其他语言的TEMPS,它在多语种或跨语言环境中的有效性仍然是一个有待解决的问题. 我们的时间监督是通过合成模板和基于规则的、海德泰姆标记的资源构建的,它支撑着锚定的、可解决的时间表达方式;隐含或高度模糊的参考和事件关系(如TempReason Level 3)超出了我们目前的范围,薄弱的监督继承了基础标记者的任何噪音。 时间 - 语义权重 α\ alpha 被选用一个从 MRR 中分离出来的搁置验证基准, 它保持协议的统一但接受覆盖成本: 在 Tempereason 上, 验证 MRR 峰值为 α = 0.8\ alpha = 0.8, 添加 TEMPS 降低所有四个主干线的回调@ 5 , 其中两个主干线的 NDCG@ 5 , 并且基于规则的 SUTime 控制在每一个公尺上都超过了它 。 我们报告这种情况,而不是围绕它;所学编码器的好处集中在专题和时间相关性冲突,而不是放在一个现成的标记器已经解决的询问上。 所报告的结果来自一次培训(种子42),统计意义是通过查询而不是通过培训种子来衡量的。 TEMPS还具有模型不可知性,因此继承了它所增强的语义主干部分的偏差和事实差距,我们接受这种权衡,以确保模块化和易于整合。 检索单元是多达512个令牌的通道,无论它包含的很多时间表达式是怎样的集合崩溃成一个单一的高斯语,对于长的或时间上的差异性段落来说,这是一个失落的总结;没有时间表达式的段落仍然在推断中被编码,但被保存在时间训练之外,因此他们的高斯语没有校正,语义分支是它们排位的. 我们的下游证据基于一项单一的端到端任务(TimeQA RAG,带有Quen2.5-7B-Instruct),因为我们没有找到第二个基准,根据一个可比协议,既能提供真正的时间检索限制,又能提供可靠的答案级地面真相。 最后,虽然增加的时间编码引入了少量的计算间接费用,但仍远远低于为可比收益而向更大的模型扩展的成本。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: TEMPS is foundational retrieval research and is not tied to a specific deployment. Because it is model-agnostic, it inherits any biases or factual gaps of the semantic backbone it augments; in time-sensitive, high-stakes domains such as clinical or legal search, temporally miscalibrated retrieval could surface misleading evidence, and downstream applications should therefore validate temporal alignment before relying on it. We use only synthetic and publicly available research data and release our artifacts for research use only.
blocks.zh: TEMPS是基础检索研究,不与具体部署挂钩. 由于它是模型不可知的,它继承了它所增强的语义主干的任何偏差或事实空白;在时间敏感、高吸积的领域,如临床或法律搜索,时间错译的检索可能表面产生误导性证据,因此下游应用在依赖它之前应验证时间吻合. 我们只使用人工合成和公开的研究数据,并释放我们的文物仅供研究使用。

blocks.en: C.2 Benchmarks and Metrics

blocks.en: We evaluate our system using three temporal benchmarks: TimeQA Chen et al. (2021) assesses the capability to understand the time scope of evolving facts within long documents, specifically evaluating temporal understanding of anchored and resolvable time mentions. TempReason Tan et al. (2023) evaluates specific reasoning levels, combining abstract logic rules (Level 1) and grounding events to valid time ranges (Level 2). We omit Level 3 from this study, as it focuses on event-event relations, whereas our research targets temporal relations covered by the first two levels. TS-Retriever Wu et al. (2024) focuses on the retrieval stage by testing the distinction of semantically similar documents based on temporal constraints via explicit (specific years), implicit (vague periods), and hybrid (ranges) query types. Together, these benchmarks provide a comprehensive assessment of factual, retrieval-based, and arithmetic temporal reasoning, sharing the common feature of evaluating time-sensitive retrieval from a given set of documents . We additionally use TimeQA for downstream RAG evaluation by passing the top-5 retrieved passages to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Yang et al. (2024) and evaluating the generated answer.

(2023年)评价具体推理水平,将抽象逻辑规则(一级)和定点事件合并到有效的时间范围(二级). 我们在本研究中忽略了第三级,因为它侧重于事件与事件的关系,而我们的研究针对的是前两个级别涵盖的时间关系。 TS 检索器 Wu等人(2024年)侧重于检索阶段,通过明确(特定年限),隐含(vague period),以及混合(范围)查询类型,测试基于时间限制的模拟类似文件的区别. 这些基准共同对事实、检索和算术时间推理作了全面评估,具有评价从某一组文件检索时间性的共同特点。 我们额外使用TimeQA来进行下游RAG评价,将最高5检索的段落传递给Quen2.5-7B-Instruct Yang et al.(2024)并评价生成的答案.

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on an HPC partition. Each compute node provides two AMD EPYC 7543 CPUs (64 physical cores, 128 threads in total), 512 GiB of DDR4 memory, and eight NVIDIA A100-SXM4 GPUs with 80 GB of HBM2 memory each, interconnected via NVLink and NVSwitch. Training was performed on a single node with exclusive allocation, distributing the workload across all eight A100 GPUs through PyTorch’s distributed launcher ( torchrun , one process per GPU) for a batch size of 2,048. Training the temporal module for three epochs over the full corpus took approximately 4 wall-clock hours on the eight A100 GPUs. Training and evaluation scripts, the trained temporal module, and the training-data generation pipeline are released at https://github.com/aldebaran-care/TEMPS .
